rationale: React Native 0.87 pulls Metro 0.87, which pulls image-size 1.2.1. The two listed image-size infinite-loop DoS advisories have no patched upstream image-size release as of 2026-08-25. The known exposure is in the Node/Metro bundling toolchain, not the app's media import/render path. Keep this exception narrow and temporary; any new high/critical advisory or package fanout must fail CI.
